mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity and corporate output growth, which increases earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units (HOUST) signals weak residential construction and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a strong increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) > 0.5% in 3 months signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal aggressive monetary tightening during a strong labor market, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% and UNRATE falls > 0.1% in the last month
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% and UNRATE falls > 0.1% in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
